name: Dry Brush
description: Every key is one stroke of a brush on paper: it lands, presses, runs short of ink and splits into hairs of sound, lifts with a tail and leaves a stain that goes on sounding.

params.name: Script
params.description: The stroke the hand makes: held level, a dot, a thin start that swells to a hook, a heavy start that thins, a trembling line, or a stamp. Heard from the next key.

params.name: Brush
params.description: What touches the paper: warm hair, a hollow bright reed pen, a thick low edge, a feather that is mostly air, or a round finger. Heard from the next key.

params.name: Paper
params.description: What the stroke is made on. Silk is clear, rice paper is soft and stains deeply, rough paper catches the hairs, stone rings under the brush.

params.name: Ink
params.description: How much ink the brush carries. Little runs out within the first second and leaves thin hairs; much lands with a blot, stays full and stains the paper deeper.

params.name: Pressure
params.description: How hard the brush is pressed. Light touches with the tip alone, thin and pure; heavy opens it until every hair sounds, full and bright. Harder keys press more.

params.name: Speed
params.description: How fast the hand moves. It sets how long each script takes, how loudly and how brightly the brush rubs on the paper and how quickly the ink flows.

params.name: Dryness
params.description: How hairs behave when they run short. Low thins them smoothly; high lets them skip, scratch and part from each other, and at the top the stroke begins half dry.

params.name: Redip
params.description: How often a held stroke is dipped again. At zero never; higher refills it sooner, with a small splash, and each new key refills the strokes held beside it.

params.name: Bristle spread
params.description: How far the hairs stand apart: their tuning around the note, and how raggedly they land. At zero they speak as one.

params.name: Grain
params.description: How much of the paper's tooth is heard in the stroke: the rubbing of the brush and a fine flutter on every hair.

params.name: Shade
params.description: The colour of the ink. Dark keeps the stroke near its lowest partials; pale lets the upper ones through.

params.name: String
params.description: How loud the string under the paper is. The landing plucks it, the moving brush rubs it and the lift damps it. Towards the top the hairs give way to it.

params.name: Bleed
params.description: How much the paper drinks: a soft wandering copy of the stroke comes in slowly behind it and outlives the key. At the top it takes some of the stroke's own weight.

params.name: Soak
params.description: How slowly the stain spreads and how long it takes to dry once the stroke has left it.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How gently the brush lands. A quick landing also plucks the string and knocks the paper.

params.name: Entry lean
params.description: Pitch at which the stroke enters, below or above the note, before it settles there as the brush takes hold.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the brush takes to leave the paper after the key is let go.

params.name: Tail
params.description: How far the last hairs drag on past the lift. At zero the whole brush leaves at once; high leaves a long thin line, and the heart of a struck mark lasts longer.

params.name: Tail lean
params.description: Where the pitch goes as the brush lifts: down, up, or nowhere.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the hairs of each stroke lie between the speakers.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Twenty-eight narrow tuned bands per key, each with an ink store, a string under the paper and a slow stain; voiced by measurement.
